ios.desc:
Transform Your Saved Social Videos Into Organized, Actionable Knowledge

Stop losing amazing content in your social media saves! Trott is the AI-powered organizer that transforms your saved Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok videos into a searchable, categorized personal knowledge base - whether it's recipes, workouts, travel destinations, product reviews, or DIY projects. It also shows you a minute-wise transcript with support for skipping to that particular minute for YouTube, along with video structure analysis.

THE UNIVERSAL SAVE PROBLEM:
- 94% of saved social content is never viewed again
- Average user has 400+ saved videos across platforms
- Finding specific content is nearly impossible
- Valuable information stays buried and forgotten

HOW TROTT'S AI WORKS:
1. Share ANY video to Trott with one tap
2. Advanced AI identifies content type automatically
3. Extracts category-specific actionable data
4. Get instant notifications when processing completes
5. Everything becomes searchable and useful

INTELLIGENT CATEGORY RECOGNITION:

RECIPES & COOKING
- Auto-extracted ingredients lists
- Prep time and cooking duration
- Step-by-step instructions
- Dietary tags (vegan, keto, gluten-free)
- Search by ingredient or cuisine type

FITNESS & WORKOUTS
- Exercise breakdowns with reps/sets
- Equipment requirements
- Target muscle groups
- Workout duration and difficulty
- Search by exercise type or time

TRAVEL & DESTINATIONS
- Location extraction with coordinates
- Direct Google Maps integration
- Activity and attraction details
- Multi-stop route planning
- Search by destination or vibe

PRODUCTS & REVIEWS
- Product names and brands
- Price comparisons
- Purchase links
- Pro/con summaries
- Search by category or feature

And many more categories


SMART FEATURES:

PINTEREST-STYLE VISUAL ORGANIZATION
- Beautiful grid layout by category
- Visual thumbnails for quick browsing
- Instant access to original videos

NATURAL LANGUAGE SEARCH
- Find content the way you remember it
- "That 15-minute pasta recipe"
- "Ab workout without equipment"
- "Hidden cafe in Tokyo"

AI ASSISTANT CHAT
- Ask questions about any saved content
- Get recommendations from your library
- Combine information across categories
- Personalized insights

MULTI-PLATFORM SUPPORT
- Instagram Reels
- YouTube Shorts & Videos
- More platforms coming soon

WHY TROTT?
- Never lose valuable content again
- Transform endless scrolling into organized knowledge
- Actually USE what you save
- One ap

android.desc:
Trott turns the reels, videos, posts and articles you save into notes you can actually use. If you save recipes, workouts and travel ideas and never open them again, Trott is for you: share a save, get a note.

Share something to Trott from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, X or your browser. Moments later you get the key points, the steps, the places and the products, sorted into your searchable library.

WHAT TROTT PULLS OUT
• Recipe notes: ingredients, timings and steps
• Workout notes: exercises, sets and reps, equipment
• Travel notes: places, with map links
• Product notes: names, prices, pros and cons
• Study and learning notes: the key ideas, plus a minute-by-minute outline for YouTube videos

FIND IT AGAIN
Search your saved reels the way you remember them: "that 15-minute pasta", "ab workout without equipment", "hidden cafe in Tokyo".

ASK TROTT
Ask a question and get an answer drawn from everything you've saved.

FOR YOU
Small memory decks bring back what you saved, so good ideas don't get buried.

TROTT ON THE WEB
Open your library on a bigger screen, group saves into projects with pages and canvases, and keep sources together.

MORE
• Reddit posts, X posts and web articles, alongside Instagram, YouTube and TikTok
• Sticky notes on any saved video
• More accurate summaries

PLANS
• Free: 5 saves and 5 Ask questions every month
• Every new account gets 7 days of Plus free: 10 saves and 5 Ask questions, no card needed
• Plus: 30 saves and 30 Ask questions a month, plus Trott on the web
• Pro: 80 saves and 100 Ask questions a month, Trott on the web, and priority processing

A save is one post, article or video up to 3 minutes; longer videos use one save per 3 minutes. Credits you already bought keep working.

Plus and Pro are auto-renewing subscriptions, billed monthly or yearly through Google Play. They renew unless cancelled before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Google Play → Payments & subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://trott.hattimatimlabs.in/privacy

quotes.text:
I built Trott out of frustration with my own “Saved” folders on Instagram and YouTube. I’d save reels and shorts—workout tips, recipes, travel spots—thinking I’d find them again later. But, like most people, I ended up with a black hole of unsorted videos: no search, no filters, and if I ever did find the right video again, I’d have to dig through the whole thing just to get that one detail I needed.

When I tried looking for solutions, I found only genre-specific apps or tools that demanded manual uploads or new workflows. None felt like they understood how real users behave or save content. So I decided to build Trott.

What makes Trott different?

You can share any Instagram Reel or YouTube Short (TikTok support launches next week) to Trott, straight from your phone’s native share menu—no manual uploads.

Trott uses AI to extract relevant info automatically (ingredients, places, products, etc.) and sorts everything for you.

It’s fully searchable with natural language. Just type something like “that Kyoto café from Instagram” and Trott finds it.

For travel videos, it can even produce Google Maps routes from extracted locations.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/trott/id6751728352
Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.hattimatimlabs.trott&hl=en_IN

I’d love to hear how you organize your own saved content—or if you’ve just given up and let it pile up like I used to. Open to all questions, feedback, and bug reports. Happy to discuss the tech …
